reviews.text: We got quotes from several roofing companies, but this team stood out as the most professional. The whole process was easy and comfortable—no pushy sales tactics or pressure to buy more than we needed. Communication was great, with fast responses and clear updates by phone and email. The crew, led by Miguel, arrived right on schedule and were very friendly. They finished the roofing job even faster than expected, and you can really see the quality and care they put into their work. We’re extremely happy with the results and would happily recommend them to anyone needing roofing, gutters, or gutter covers in Texas!
reviews.author: Tamara Lopez

reviews.text: I recently had my roof replaced and the whole process was smooth and easy from the start. Getting a quote and scheduling the installation was simple, and Miguel walked me through all my options, warranties, and costs in a way that was clear and straightforward. The quote itself was easy to understand, with no confusing fine print to worry about. Miguel has years of experience and clearly chooses his crew with care. It was a pleasure working with a roofing company that truly values honesty, has a solid reputation, and delivers top-quality work at a fair price. When I shared the cost with coworkers, they agreed it was an excellent deal. The price was affordable, but they still used great materials and didn’t cut corners. They also offer a strong warranty on their work at no extra charge, which gave me even more peace of mind. My new roof looks fantastic, and I decided to add gutter covers as well, which was another helpful service they provided. I highly recommend this roofing company to anyone looking for honest service and quality results. From beginning to end, you’ll be happy you chose them.
reviews.author: Meagan Figueroa

reviews.text: Our experience with Garcia Brothers Roofers LLC was excellent from start to finish. Miguel was extremely professional and kept us updated every step of the way. He arrived right on time to inspect our roof, coming fully prepared and quickly provided us with a detailed estimate. During the inspection, Miguel showed us photos he had taken, highlighting some worn, cracked, and lifting shingles that needed attention. He took care of all the paperwork, including filing for the necessary permits with Arlington officials and our property management team, and even arranged for a dumpster to be delivered. The entire process, from our first meeting to the completed roof installation (including permit approvals), took less than three weeks! The actual roofing work was finished in just two days, which included removing two layers of old shingles before installing the new ones. Miguel and his crew did an outstanding job with cleanup—the area was spotless, and you couldn’t even tell a roofing project had taken place, except for the beautiful new roof. The dumpster was removed promptly the next day. Miguel also provided us with photos of the finished work for our records. We are very happy with the results and highly recommend this company for anyone needing roofing services in Arlington.
reviews.author: Brayden Farrell

reviews.text: from start to finish, working with this roofing company has been a really smooth and great experience. i called them to check out a leak in my roof, and roger came by to do a really detailed inspection. he explained clearly why a roof replacement was a good idea, showing me lots of photos to back it up, and he walked me through the whole process step by step. the installation team was on time, well organized, and you could tell they had a lot of experience with roofs, especially in the hot texas sun. roger, who managed the whole project, was super helpful and always ready to answer all my questions. he kept me updated with pictures during the work and even shared aerial shots when it was all done, which made it easy to see what had been fixed. clean up after the job was excellent, and my new roof looks great. i highly recommend this roofing company for anyone needing roof repairs or a new roof.
reviews.author: Marisa C

reviews.text: After moving into my home in Arlington, I found a leak in the attic coming from my old metal shingle roof. I reached out to a few roofing companies, but none of them seemed to know much about repairing these types of metal shingles. When I contacted Garcia Brothers Roofers LLC, Leonard immediately recognized the kind of shingles I had and understood exactly how to handle the repair. They had a matching product and were able to carefully replace just the damaged section, blending it in with the existing roof. The installation crew was quick to respond and showed a lot of skill during the job. Now, several months later, the repaired area still looks great and there are no more leaks. I’m very happy with the results and the professional service I received.
reviews.author: Brandy Z

reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with this roofing company during my recent project in Arlington. Miguel, the consultant who managed my roof replacement, was very professional, attentive, and thorough from start to finish. He carefully inspected and documented all the damage on my roof, making the insurance process much easier for me. Thanks to Miguel’s attention to detail, what began as a small repair for just a few shingles turned into a complete roof replacement, fully covered by my insurance (except for the deductible). I really appreciate how Miguel and the team made the whole process smooth and stress-free. They did an outstanding job!
reviews.author: kennedy levine

reviews.text: After the company that first put on my roof kept making excuses and didn't actually fix my leak, I called Garcia Brothers Roofers LLC. From my first conversation with Miguel in the office to speaking with Ayden at the end, everything was handled professionally. They kept me updated, explained everything clearly, and were always friendly. Theodore came out to do the repair. He was very approachable, took his time, and made sure the job was done right, even working late into the evening to finish up. I’m really happy with the results and would recommend them to anyone needing roofing help.
reviews.author: Gladys Blackburn

reviews.text: After a strong storm hit Arlington, I reached out to this roofing company for help. Even though they had a lot of customers needing repairs, Miguel came by the very next day to inspect and measure my roof. He provided an estimate right then and there, and the final price matched exactly what he quoted. Because so many homes needed work after the storm, I had to wait a few weeks for my turn, which made sense given the situation. When it was time for the job, Miguel and his crew really impressed me. They handled my large, complicated roof efficiently, finishing everything in just four days. Their work included removing two old chimneys, cleaning out all my gutters, and installing new gutter guards to help with all the leaves we get in Arlington. Throughout the whole process, Miguel was always upbeat, professional, and easy to talk to—he made the experience stress-free. The photos I took on the third day show just how much progress they made. I’m very pleased with how everything turned out and would definitely recommend this roofing team.
reviews.author: Wanda L

reviews.text: If I could give more than 5 stars, I would! Jorge was very detailed when explaining the entire roofing process from beginning to end. He made sure I always knew when the crew would start, and stayed on-site to answer my questions and keep me updated about what was needed. The team, led by Foreman Miguel with help from Ayden and others, did an excellent job! They were very professional when removing the old shingles and installing my new roof and gutters, and my house looks so much better now. They also did a fantastic job cleaning up after the work. I’m extremely happy with the results, and now I feel confident when it rains. I highly recommend their roofing services!
reviews.author: Vanessa Patterson

reviews.text: After seeing great reviews online, I reached out to a local roofing company and was impressed by how quickly they responded. Roger called me right away and scheduled a roof inspection and estimate for the very next day—talk about fast service! Soon after, their crew arrived and began working on removing and replacing the flat porch roof. They used high-quality materials that matched the original shingle color and style perfectly. I’m really pleased with how everything turned out, especially the trim and drip edge details. I highly recommend this roofing company for anyone looking for excellent workmanship and a hassle-free experience. Roger was professional and easy to work with throughout the whole process.
reviews.author: Sydney Flynn

reviews.text: Garcia Brothers Roofers LLC was the only roofing company that agreed to help with my small siding repair in Arlington. Other roofers wouldn’t even consider my job. Leonard came out and replaced the old wood gable with new metal siding, since woodpeckers kept damaging it. The job was tricky because the gable is high up and there’s an existing awning, but that didn’t slow him down at all! He also installed snow guards on our metal roof to help protect our new gutters from heavy rain runoff, which is important here in Texas. To top it off, he even hung up my fake owl to keep woodpeckers away. Throughout the whole process, Leonard and his coworker were professional, easy to talk to, and respectful. I highly recommend this roofing crew for anyone in Arlington needing quality roof or siding work.
reviews.author: annette landry

reviews.text: We hired a roofing company to replace the metal roof on our sanctuary, put a new asphalt roof on our parsonage, and install brand new gutters on the sanctuary. Ayden and his crew did a fantastic job on both roofs, and the end results look great! The company offered excellent value for the quality of work we received. Ayden even suggested adding a custom metal cross to the top of our steeple, which really made everything stand out. When a small issue with the flashing and soffit came up later, his team responded quickly and fixed it right away without any hassle. We are very happy with the work and the service we received.
reviews.author: Lindsey12 G

reviews.text: miguel and jorge were awesome! they really went above and beyond what we expected. from the first meeting all the way to the final clean-up, they made everything about replacing our roof super easy. the communication was always quick and clear, and we loved getting progress pictures as the roofing work went along. i would definitely recommend this roofing team and plan to use them again in the future. the quality of the roof, new gutters, pergola cover, window screens, and fence stain is fantastic, and we’re excited to have them work on our new garage doors soon. top-notch customer service and great craftsmanship—very happy with our experience in arlington!
reviews.author: Darrell20 S

reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience working with Garcia Brothers Roofers LLC. Our project involved replacing an old fireplace, rebuilding the entire two-story exterior chimney chase, and updating the roofline with new shingles to ensure proper venting for a new gas fireplace. Miguel and his team took great care to make sure everything was completed correctly, including coordinating all the necessary city inspections and working with other contractors to finish the exterior. The crew's attention to detail and commitment to quality really stood out, and we are very happy with the final results. We highly recommend their roofing services to anyone looking for dependable and skilled roofers.
reviews.author: Eli H

reviews.text: Working with this roofing company in Arlington was a great experience. Theodore explained everything clearly, from the steps of the roof replacement to the quality materials they use. I appreciated how quickly they got back to me with a quote and how fast the whole job was finished. From my first phone call to a brand new roof, it all moved along smoothly. The crew was professional, detailed, and made sure to clean up all the mess when they finished. They were also very careful not to damage my landscaping, which really impressed me. There was one small mix-up with scheduling, but after I talked to Theodore about it, he took care of things right away. In the end, I was extremely happy with the results and would definitely recommend this team to anyone needing a new roof in Arlington. They replaced my roof with new shingles and added a stylish black metal accent, which looks fantastic.
reviews.author: Karina Walters

reviews.text: When we bought our house, we needed a new roof for insurance reasons, and this roofing crew was highly recommended. Roger was very responsive and professional, taking plenty of time to answer all my questions about the process. The team worked quickly and did a great job cleaning up the yard afterward—I didn’t even realize how important that was until I saw them using their metal detectors to pick up every nail and piece of debris! Later on, we had a small issue with our gutters, and they came back promptly to make sure everything was flowing just right. This is a reliable local roofing company with friendly folks who truly care about their customers.
reviews.author: K Gibbs

reviews.text: I needed a reliable roofer in Arlington to handle a full roof replacement, including fixing some unexpected rotten wood and taking care of chimney repairs. After searching around, I was happy to find Garcia Brothers Roofers LLC. From the start, they were professional and detailed, giving me a fair estimate and getting everything done quickly. I always felt like they were being honest and giving me the best advice, while making sure every part of the job was done right. Jorge and the crew listened to all my questions and made sure my concerns were addressed. Everyone on the team was friendly, respectful, and clearly skilled at what they do. They did a fantastic job cleaning up afterward, leaving the property spotless. As a nice surprise, they even replaced the roof on my kids’ playhouse. Overall, I highly recommend them if you need any roofing work done in Arlington.
reviews.author: Marilyn Castaneda

reviews.text: After noticing a water stain on the ceiling in a second-floor bedroom, I suspected there was a roof leak that needed attention. I began reaching out for estimates, but it was surprisingly tough to find anyone interested in a roof repair instead of trying to sell a whole roof replacement. Thankfully, I found Garcia Brothers Roofers LLC online and filled out their web form. Miguel called me back within a couple of hours, which was much quicker than the other companies I tried. Scheduling an appointment for an estimate was fast and convenient. They originally booked me for a Sunday afternoon, but later that day, Miguel called to let me know there was an earlier opening, which I appreciated. I expected them to come by, take a quick look, and give me an estimate. To my surprise, after checking out the problem, Miguel said if they had the right shingles nearby, they could take care of the repair right away. He found the correct shingle color from an old piece on my roof and, within less than an hour, was back and ready to work. The repair included removing an old satellite dish that was causing the leak, taking off damaged shingles, replacing the tar paper, adding a water barrier, and then re-shingling the area. Throughout the process, he took pictures before, during, and after, which really helped me feel confident in the quality of the work. The new shingles matched perfectly with the existing roof. From the estimate to the completed repair, the whole process took about two and a half hours. The customer service was truly outstanding. Miguel clearly has a lot of experience and still takes pride in doing a great job. On top of that, their pricing was better than the few other companies that actually called me back. If you need roof repairs done quickly, professionally, and at a fair price, I definitely recommend these guys!
reviews.author: Chloe R

data.summary: Reviews appear largely authentic with high detail and varied perspectives. The high volume of positive reviews is plausible for a quality contractor. Minor concerns include repetitive employee mentions and some stylistic similarities, but these are not strong enough to indicate systematic fakery. No substantive complaints or red flags found.
fake_signals: Some reviews have similar phrasing and structure (e.g., 'from start to finish...'), 'Miguel' appears in 7 of 10 sampled 5-star reviews, suggesting possible templating or focus on a single employee.

positive_evidence: Reviewer mentions Miguel walked them through 'all my options, warranties, and costs'.

authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific project details (metal shingle repair, insurance claims, storm damage, chimney rebuild), varied writing styles and capitalization, mentions of different crew members (Miguel, Roger, Leonard, Ayden, Theodore, Jorge), and specific locations (Arlington). The 3-4 star reviews are positive but not perfectly 5-star, adding credibility.
data.discrepancy_explanation: No significant discrepancies; only Google reviews are available and show a consistent high rating.
